title: How Much Regularization Survives Averaging? Update Masking in Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.23286v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated learning on non-IID data seeks flat minima to generalize across clients, and existing methods borrow sharpness-aware minimization from centralized training. There is a second way to reach flat minima, in which the regularization comes for free from noise added to the parameter updates, and it has never been carried over to the federated setting. We show the reason. Masking charges the optimizer for moving in sharp directions. We prove that when each client draws its own mask, federated averaging weakens that charge by exactly the cohort size, and that giving every client the same mask brings it back by a factor equal to the inverse gradient diversity of the cohort. In our experiment setting on CIFAR-10, that factor is 1.19 out of a possible 10. translated_title: 平均化能保留多少正则化？联邦学习中的更新掩蔽
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23286v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在非独立同分布数据上的联邦学习寻求平坦最小值以在客户端之间泛化，现有方法借鉴了集中训练中的锐度感知最小化。还有第二种达到平坦最小值的方式，其中正则化来自参数更新中加入的噪声，这种噪声是免费获得的，但从未被引入联邦设置中。我们展示了其原因。掩蔽会对优化器在尖锐方向上的移动收取费用。我们证明，当每个客户端绘制自己的掩码时，联邦平均会将该费用削弱恰好等于群体规模的大小，而给所有客户端相同的掩码则会通过等于群体逆梯度多样性的因子将其恢复。在我们对CIFAR-10的实验设置中，该因子为1.19，而可能的最大值为10。关闭小批量采样将其提升至8.96，而将数据异质性改变一百倍则使其保持在1.17到1.50之间。保持正则化训练的配置
tldr: 本文证明联邦平均会削弱基于掩蔽的正则化效果，其削弱程度与客户端群体规模成正比，而统一掩码可通过逆梯度多样性因子恢复该效果，从而揭示联邦学习中噪声正则化保留的关键机制。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that federated averaging weakens masking-based regularization by exactly the cohort size, while identical masks across clients restore it by the inverse gradient diversity factor, revealing the key mechanism for preserving noise regularization in federated learning.
